meta: Plan a trip itinerary on a budget with AI without cramming five or six stops into a day and rushing past everything.

muc.title: Too many stops
muc.text: A common mistake when asking AI for an itinerary is five or six stops a day: all rushing, no enjoying.

muc.title: Days, money, pace
muc.text: Tell AI how many days, your budget, who's coming and your pace, for example one or two stops per half day.

muc.title: Real travel times
muc.text: Ask AI to include real travel times between stops and leave gaps, because traffic always takes longer than you think.

muc.title: Opening hours
muc.text: AI can get opening hours or ticket prices wrong, so check them on the official website.

muc.title: Your next trip
muc.text: Give AI the number of days, budget and pace of your next trip, and ask for a relaxed itinerary with travel times.
